integrity: The finite-window obstruction and the uniform tail estimate are proved directly. Published results are used only for the properties of the full infinite-coordinate norm and for broader literature comparison. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the irrational-rotation model on the circle and to nonempty finite coordinate truncations of the Dantas--Kaasik--Perreau orbit norm. No assertion is made about the Daugavet property of the truncated norms or about arbitrary ergodic transformations.
title: Finite orbit truncations destroy rotundity in an ergodic Daugavet renorming
